Class ChangeAgePhase

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.game.StatePhases.ChangeAgePhase
All Implemented Interfaces:
GamePhaseBehavior, Serializable
public class ChangeAgePhase extends Object implements GamePhaseBehavior
CHANGE_AGE phase behavior. Triggered when Decks.popCard() returns an empty Optional, signaling the current age's deck is exhausted.
  1. Advances the Age (AGE_1 → AGE_2 → AGE_3)
  2. Updates available buildings for the new era
  3. Transitions to START_TURN
